build_autoencoder_kl_allegro: build an AutoencoderKLAllegro model to encode and decode video frames into latent representations
encode_videos_with_allegro: encode a batch of video tensors into latent distributions using AutoencoderKLAllegro encode method
decode_latents_with_allegro: decode latent vectors back into video frames using AutoencoderKLAllegro decode method
create_tiled_encode: create a tiled encoding pipeline to process large videos in overlapping spatial and temporal tiles
create_tiled_decode: create a tiled decoding pipeline to reconstruct large videos from latents using overlapping tile blending
